It's great that a new generation of artists recognize their predecessors.
I remember when my first album was released.
The success was beyond my wildest dreams.
And the fans, wow!
I couldn't go out in public without people noticing me and trying to take my picture.

Retirement's not so bad.
Anyway, there are a lot of people to thank, but I should begin by thanking my manager, Manuel Garcia.
Without him, my career could never have gotten started.
